title: Photocatalytic degradation of methyl orange at different pH values by NaYF4:Yb3+,Tm3+@TiO2 microrod composite photocatalysts under NIR excitation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,29195-29206
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00088F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yanna Tang, Jia Zeng
NaYF4:Yb3+,Tm3+@TiO2 microrod composite photocatalysts were fabricated via a hydrothermal method combined with a two-step wet-chemical coating strategy. The core role of FRET in enhancing their NIR photocatalysis was revealed.
